summary: 22-year-old ATV rider plunged 212 ft off a cliff at The Notch atop Kennebec Pass in snowy conditions; 30 rescuers worked 8 hours in the dark, hauling him up a 70-degree slope with a 213-ft rope
location: The Notch, Kennebec Pass, La Plata Mountains
responding_agency: La Plata County SAR + Durango Fire Protection District, Fort Lewis Mesa Fire Protection District
notes: approx: crash reported ~4:30pm Sat Nov 18 2023, extracted after midnight; rib/leg/back injuries; story published Wed Nov 22 2023
